title: 日本ダービーの後に・瞳に映ったもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I knew it! I knew I'd become this year's Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How could it possibly be anyone else? Ohohoho! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course! I am a first-rate Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Sorry! Would you mind looking this way and posing for a picture?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course! Now, everyone will know who I…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Oh, nothing. It's just, a more victorious-looking background would be more appropriate, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sure, in front of the racetrack might be conventional, but wouldn't it suit me better to be standing on a gorgeously decorated stage?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Everyone, there's been a change of plans! The photo shoot in this location is finished!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Instead, I'm granting you the right to capture my brilliance while I perform on stage!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That is all! Good day!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Wha—hold on just a second! Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text: Ugh, typical nepo baby. We can't just up and change our schedules. How inconsiderate!

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text: She was so arrogant about her win as well, like it was meant to be. This was the Derby for crying out loud! Some modesty would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can hear the photographers and journalists complaining…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now, everyone will know who I—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But something has caught King Halo's attention. I follow her gaze and find…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sob… Sob…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Mom… I couldn't become the best in Japan…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I…

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text: Hey! Where'd the winner go? Was she serious about making us interview her at the concert?!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I set everything up here for nothing, huh…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You're late! You should know better than to keep me waiting.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "I'm sorry" isn't what I want to hear. I swear, can't you indulge me a bit more? I just won the Derby, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm a first-rate Umamusume, which means you need to start acting like a first-rate trai—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph… It's my mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I wonder if she's ready to acknowledge me after seeing my victory.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose I should see what she has to say. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hello? Mother? Hehe, I don't suppose you caught the Der—

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes, I saw it. It was quite amazing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: It's been a good while since I've seen someone capture the hearts of the crowd with their running like Special Week.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But I'm the one who won…

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's right. You were lucky, so you should end on this high note before things turn sour.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: And just what in the world was that stunt you pulled during the press conference? You don't just walk away from the media like that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: B-but…

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Abandoning your responsibilities just because you won is what a child would do.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: If you keep up this behavior, the future will not be kind to you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: You won't survive unless you fix your attitude.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Come home before you embarrass yourself even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep. Click.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer. We're continuing to the Kikuka Sho. I plan to leave my mark there as well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to let things end as they are now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What does she know? I will survive. And I won't be a disgrace.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll continue to shine throughout the Classics like the star I am!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I won't lose to anyone, be it Seiun Sky or Special Week.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm King Halo! An Umamusume of talent!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And I deserve to be recognized! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her laugh doesn't carry the same spirit as usual.
